description: Source code for ASN1_BIT_STRING handling in BoringSSL, including functions for setting, encoding, decoding, and manipulating ASN.1 bit strings.

methods.name: ASN1_BIT_STRING_set
methods.description: Sets the value of an ASN1_BIT_STRING from a byte array.

methods.name: asn1_bit_string_length
methods.description: Calculates the length of the ASN1_BIT_STRING and outputs padding bits.

methods.name: ASN1_BIT_STRING_num_bytes
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes needed to represent the ASN1_BIT_STRING if no padding bits are present.

methods.name: c2i_ASN1_BIT_STRING
methods.description: Decodes DER format data into ASN1_BIT_STRING.

methods.name: ASN1_BIT_STRING_set_bit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the ASN1_BIT_STRING.

methods.name: ASN1_BIT_STRING_get_bit
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific bit in the ASN1_BIT_STRING.

methods.name: ASN1_BIT_STRING_check
methods.description: Checks if the bit string contains only bits specified by the flags.
